'''Eileen Frances Stevens''' (born January 7, 1982) is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Stevens joined the cast of the {{pkmn|animated series}} during [[S11|the eleventh season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. Her first role on the show was [[Spring and Summer (DP062)|Spring]] in the {{aniseries|DP|''Diamond and Pearl'' series}} episode ''[[DP062|Tanks for the Memories!]]''. In the {{aniseries|BW|''Black & White'' series}}, she acquired one of her most significant roles yet, providing the voice of {{an|Iris}}. Her other notable roles in ''Black & White'' include {{OBP|Zorua|M13}} (in the {{pkmn|movie}} ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''), [[Jupiter]], {{an|Lyra}}, and [[Elesa]]. In the {{aniseries|XY|''XY'' series}}, her notable roles are [[Serena's Braixen|Serena's Fennekin and Braixen]], as well as {{an|Aria}}. Stevens left the animated series after the {{aniseries|SM|''Sun & Moon'' series}} episode ''[[SM062|Acting True to Form!]]'', with her roles being passed on to other actors. Stevens would later return to voice Iris in the {{aniseries|JN}} episode ''[[JN065|Thrash of the Titans!]]'', before leaving the show again, with her role of Iris being recast.
